differs_from_en: STALE ON PURPOSE (S12): the hour of 1 760 RUB from before the last rise (the last but one of the history) and the before-rise totals: front discs and pads 12 268 (ledger s12.brake_price.ru stale; current 12 520), rear discs and pads, front pads, rear pads, inspection 650 (current 700), fluid 2 340 (current 2 480).

Signed «В. С.» (cast: slot F3 signs his order comments so), dated nine months before T; he resigned in week T-30. The date is after the second rise (eleven months before T), so the hour it shows was the current one when it was written.
Its other answers (no disc machining, 30 days on the work) agree with the current pages.
